The concept favours not only visual grandeur, but also the creation of sophisticated interiors, highly customisable and developed to offer a level of comfort and refinement rarely found in the residential market. The composition of the tower integrates different categories of housing, aimed at diversified profiles of residents. The initial typologies include two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, designed with functional layouts and a contemporary language, while always maintaining high standards of materials and finishes. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. On the upper levels, typologies of a frankly exclusive character emerge, such as the suspended mansions of four and six bedrooms, which occupy generous areas and provide a true experience of an independent house within a vertical tower. Some of these units include a private pool, cinema rooms, play areas, reading spaces and areas for wellness activities, such as rooms prepared for massages or fully equipped gyms. These residences are also distinguished by the high number of private parking spaces, which can vary between four and twelve, ensuring safety and practicality. At the top of the structure are the most emblematic residences of the project: large penthouses designed in full floors or in duplexes, with exceptional surfaces that far exceed the typical dimensions of luxury apartments. These units include infinity pools with panoramic views, formal and informal dining areas, main kitchens and secondary kitchens for service, private gyms, games rooms, offices, private lounges, suites with walk-in wardrobes, bathrooms covered in noble materials and protected outdoor areas to enjoy the view over the city. In some cases, residents have a private lift with direct access to the interior of the unit, ensuring the highest level of privacy. The building offers an extensive set of amenities that reinforce its position as a reference in the luxury real estate sector. These include large-design outdoor pools, a spa with treatment rooms, a sauna, a Turkish bath and relaxation areas, a gym equipped with state-of-the-art technology, lounges reserved for residents, meeting rooms and social spaces designed for private events. The tower also has concierge services available daily, valet assistance, permanent security staff, high-standard reception and advanced access control systems. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. The location in Business Bay guarantees a privileged connection to strategic areas of Dubai, such as Downtown, Dubai Canal, financial centres, cultural areas and some of the city's most popular gastronomic and commercial destinations. The proximity to the main traffic routes offers quick accessibility to the airport, beaches and other central neighbourhoods, making the development an ideal option for both permanent residence and investment. description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. The project offers elegantly designed interiors across a selection of premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, carefully crafted to blend modern comfort with sophisticated aesthetics. Each residence features contemporary layouts enhanced by spacious living areas and meticulous attention to detail. The interiors are equipped with stylish fitted wardrobes and fully integrated kitchen appliances, providing residents with convenience and luxury. Tower A exclusively offers fully furnished units, thoughtfully curated with tasteful furnishings and décor for immediate comfort and sophisticated living from day one. Towers B, C, and D present semi-furnished residences, allowing flexibility for personal touches to complement the refined interiors. Every apartment has been designed to create a harmonious living space that emphasizes both elegance and functionality, offering residents an exceptional lifestyle experience in a vibrant coastal setting. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.
